title: Dataverse: build solutions with coding agents using the Dataverse plugin and Work IQ
summary: Hold: Microsoft now says automatic enablement for existing Work IQ environments has been deferred, rather than starting in November 2026. The Dataverse MCP navigation also stops before the client controls it claims to reach, and the September 30 enablement date could not be confirmed.
